name: bug
description: Something does not work as documented

name: enhancement
description: A new function or a change to a function

name: security
description: A security hardening task (not a vulnerability report)

name: breaking
description: A change that is not backward compatible

name: adr
description: Needs or changes an architecture decision record

name: good first issue
description: A small task with a clear result

name: help wanted
description: The maintainers want a contribution for this

name: needs-info
description: The report does not have sufficient data

name: blocked
description: Cannot continue until a different item is done

name: duplicate
description: A different issue or pull request has this subject

name: wontfix
description: The maintainers will not do this
